subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Modernization is good when it expands access.”?
options: Sometimes it lives quietly in families, waiting for someone young to carry it forward.
It reminded Mr. Huang that not every problem needs to be fixed in the same way it was before.
It becomes unfair when it quietly assumes everyone lives the same way.
A quiet room becomes better when everyone takes care of it.

本文可直接核對「Modernization is good when it expands access. It becomes unfair when it quietly assumes everyone lives the same way.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
